title: Nostalgic Kenyan Vegetables Wrap
description: A funky, light, nostalgic Kenyan wrap grilled on banana leaves, seasoned with rice vinegar and peanut butter.
instructions: Rinse banana leaves until clean, then pat dry and lay flat on a heatproof surface.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil the surface.
Spread 1 cup cooked rice onto each banana leaf, forming a thin layer about 1 inch thick.
Evenly distribute sliced carrots, bell pepper, shredded cabbage, and cucumber over the rice.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, peanut butter, grated ginger, and minced garlic until smooth.
Drizzle the sauce mixture over the vegetables on each leaf and sprinkle toasted sesame seeds.
Fold the banana leaf over the filling, sealing edges with a teaspoon of water, then grill each wrap for 3-4 minutes per side until the leaf is slightly charred.
Remove from heat, let rest 1 minute, then unwrap to serve warm.
Optionally sprinkle chili flakes for heat.
Serve immediately with a side of fresh lime wedges.
